title: Leo, you can shine for no one and still be held
caption: for the leos who keep the porch light on

scenes.text: you're ruled by the sun, the one star that never asks to rise.
you walk in warm, and every room leans a little toward you.
you remember the birthdays. you answer at 3am. you cover the bill.
but some nights you wonder who'd stay if the lights went down.
here is what the sky knows about the sun:
it burns all night, with half the world turned away from it.
so you don't have to earn the warmth you hand out for free.
and you don't have to be dazzling to be worth keeping.
let someone read your sky first, before they ever see the glow.
it has to be mutual. warmth is meant to come back to you, too.
you can shine for no one, and still ask to be loved back.
rest now, leo. the sun comes back on its own.
